newsitem.title: UK: Zeneca seen rising on favourable 1996 result.
newsitem.headline: Zeneca seen rising on favourable 1996 result.

text.p: Shares in drugs firm Zeneca Group Plc are expected to open firmer after the company reported 1996 profits which came in at the top end of analysts' expectations.
Shares should also be underpinned by news that migraine drug Zomig was given approval for marketing in Britain, analysts said after a first glance through Zeneca's result statement.
"The results look fine and the approval for Zomig in the UK is very good news," said one analyst.
Zeneca's profit before tax and exceptional items rose 15 percent to 1.011 billion stg from 878 million stg in 1995. Market forecasts had varied between 992 million and 1.010 billion stg.
Zeneca said profits were boosted by strong sales growth, particularly from its new drugs.
The group expects further strong volume growth in 1997, although the launch costs for new products will continue to restrain short-term profit growth.
